_doc.folder: Folder the sound files are in, relative to the page (the build copies assets/third_party into it).
_doc.sounds: What plays when (D11b). Each: `files`, one or more file names in the folder (one is picked at random each time it plays), and `volume`, its own loudness (1 = as recorded; view.soundVolume scales all of them).
_doc.trainRunning: Looped while the train runs, faster on fast-forward.
_doc.endWarning: The track ahead ends within view.hornWarnCells cells and does not reach the end station: repeated, more often the closer the end.
_doc.bump: A character boosts into the train (at most once in 1.5 s per character); walking into it makes no sound.
_doc.built: A bridge or a stair is built.
_doc.blast: A stick of dynamite goes off.
_doc.mine: Each time a character's pickaxe strikes grey rock (view.swingsPerSecond sets how often), faded out when they stop.
_doc.chop: While a character chops a tree: the same.
